knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Honing levels or removes marks, and polishing then builds the sheen. The stages run in that order.
Each grit must remove the scratches left by the previous grit before the next grit is used.
The wet method at the point of cut is the main dust control for honing and polishing at every grit.
Over-grinding can loosen chips or expose aggregate on terrazzo, which changes the finish and the surface.
The sequence and machine speed come from the manufacturer and the test patch. No national standard for the method was found.

practicalCriteria: Runs the grit sequence so that each grit removes the scratches of the previous one
Keeps the wet method running through every pass
Inspects under light and records any defects
Stops over-grinding terrazzo before the chips loosen
passRule: Knowledge checks: 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate and is not granted by the knowledge check: an assessor must observe every critical practical criterion and record it.
evidenceRequired: Grit sequence record and inspection result
Water check record and defect report
stopWorkCriteria: Water feed fails and is not restored
Damaged cord or electrical fault on the machine
